blocks.text: 10 Inch Android 15 Tablet，2 in 1 tablet with keyboard, a complete bundle that includes everything you need: a detachable keyboard case, stylus pen, wireless mouse, protective case, and charging cable. This versatile 2-in-1 convertible tablet​ is powered by the latest Android 15 OS​ for a smooth, modern experience. With 8GB of RAM (3GB + 5GB expansion)​ and 32GB of storage, enjoy seamless multitasking for work, study, and entertainment. The large 6000mAh battery​ ensures all-day power, while advanced Wi-Fi 6 (2.4G/5G dual-band)​ guarantees fast, stable connectivity. Key features also include a dual-camera system (2MP + 8MP)​ for video calls and photos. It's the perfect ready-to-use kit, offering exceptional value and performance right out of the box. Complete Bundle:​ Includes Case, Stylus, Mouse, & Keyboard Android OS :​ Runs on Android 15 with 8GB RAM Long-Lasting Battery:​ 6000mAh for all-day use Fast Wi-Fi 6:​ Dual-band connectivity for smooth streaming 2-in-1 Versatility:​ Use as a laptop or a tablet

items: Android 15 with 8GB RAM：Experience buttery-smooth performance for work and play. 8GB RAM（3GB + 5GB expansion） . This ensures you can effortlessly multitask between apps, browse the web, and stream videos without lag. Coupled with the latest Android 15 OS, enjoy a smarter, more secure, and personalized user experience with access to the newest features and applications.

2 in 1 Android 15 tablet with keyboard：This isn't just a tablet; it's your complete mobile office and entertainment kit. The package includes a detachable keyboard, a protective case, a mouse, and a precision stylus. Instantly transform from an intuitive tablet for reading and drawing into a full-fledged laptop for typing documents, managing emails, or presenting ideas. It’s the all-in-one solution for students, professionals, and families, offering incredible value right out of the box.

6000mAh Battery & Wi-Fi 6：Designed to last, the robust 6000mAh battery keeps you powered through long workdays, lectures, or travel without constantly searching for an outlet. Stay connected at blazing speeds with advanced dual-band Wi-Fi 6, which provides a more stable and efficient connection on both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands. Enjoy seamless HD video streaming, smoother online gaming, and crystal-clear video calls even on crowded networks.

10 inch Display Enhanced with Practical Dual Cameras：Immerse yourself in your favorite content on a crisp 10-inch screen, ideal for watching movies, browsing the web, or video conferencing. The dual-camera system includes an 8MP rear camera for scanning documents or capturing casual photos, and a 2MP front-facing camera that’s perfect for online classes and virtual meetings, ensuring you’re always seen clearly.

Designed for Portability and Immediate Productivity：Lightweight and sleek, this tablet is your perfect companion for life on the go. The included accessories are designed for immediate use, allowing you to start being productive from the moment you open the box. Whether you're taking notes in a meeting with the stylus, or finishing an assignment on the couch with the keyboard and mouse, this versatile 2-in-1 adapts to your lifestyle effortlessly.
